title: VTC Events — Registrations — Remove — payload
description: A host removes a registration from an event — going, maybe, waitlisted or pending — with an optional note the registrant reads. A place it held passes to the waitlist. The registrant cannot re-open it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

note.description: Shown to the registrant on their registration. Plain text.

Response.title: VTC Events — Registrations — Remove — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/registrations/remove/0.3 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/registrations/remove/0.3#response.

registration.description: The registration as it now stands — `removed`, or unchanged where it had already ended.

changed.description: False where the registration was already withdrawn, declined or removed, and nothing changed.
